nphi.title: BE READY – European Research Partnership for pandemic preparedness (CSA)
nphi.actor: AGES – Austrian Agency for Health and Food Safety
nphi.with: ANRS-MIE; Statens Serum Institut; NIPH Norway; NIZP-PZH; Laboratoire national de santé; ISS; RIVM; UKRI
nphi.summary: Coordination and support action preparing a European pandemic-preparedness research partnership with a One Health approach; partners include Norway and the UK.

nphi.title: Microbiology for Development (phase V)
nphi.with: Lagos University Teaching Hospital; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut de Recherche en Sciences de la Santé (Burkina Faso); Institut Pasteur du Laos
nphi.summary: Training programme running since 2000, funded by Luxembourg's foreign ministry and LIH, hosting visiting scientists from African and Lao institutes for microbiology research.

nphi.title: MADIBA vaccine manufacturing facility – EIB/Team Europe financing
nphi.with: European Investment Bank; EU Delegation to Senegal (Team Europe)
nphi.summary: EUR 75 million EIB loan (2022), following EUR 5 million EU/EIB preparatory funding in 2021, for IPD's MADIBA vaccine manufacturing plant in Diamniadio, aimed at up to 300 million doses a year.

nphi.title: CARES – Casamance research programme on HIV resistance and sexual health
nphi.actor: Luxembourg Institute of Health (LIH) and Laboratoire national de santé (LNS)
nphi.with: ENDA Santé; hospitals and universities in Ziguinchor and Bissau; Centre hospitalier de Luxembourg; Fondation Recherche sur le SIDA; Stop Aids Now/ACCESS
nphi.summary: Luxembourg-funded operational research and training programme to reduce deaths from HIV, hepatitis B and HPV in Casamance (Senegal) and Guinea-Bissau, coordinated by LIH with LNS contributing.

nphi.title: PaReCIDS II – Lao-Luxembourg partnership for infectious disease surveillance
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Laos; National University of Laos; Lao Red Cross
nphi.summary: Luxembourg Ministry- and LIH-supported partnership for research and capacity building in infectious disease surveillance in Laos, in its second phase by 2019.

indicators.label: E. coli bloodstream infections resistant to 3rd-generation cephalosporins
